purpose: Stable event/query extension for distributed scientific knowledge and regional research continuity. It extends research_runtime_contract.json without changing ownership of communications, politics, population, construction, diplomacy, or UI systems.

external_input_events.payload: source context, destination context, path availability, one-way latency, material bandwidth constraints, confidence
external_input_events.effect: create/cancel/recalculate only affected pending knowledge transmissions and isolation state
re-evaluate only affected dissemination permissions; does not destroy archives unless a separate physical event says so
update local codified-access preservation and archive-loss risk

external_input_events.payload: tacit/facility/tooling/prototype asset ref, old context, new context, availability
external_input_events.effect: update local practice/readiness only where asset actually moved or changed control

external_input_events.payload: context ids, old/new polity ownership, fracture/reintegration type
external_input_events.effect: calculate successor/reintegrated research inheritance from factual local context state
create, merge, archive, or remap only materially divergent research contexts

external_input_events.payload: parties, sharing mode, rights, source/destination contexts, package/assets
external_input_events.effect: route through existing exchange/knowledge dissemination rules without merging technology trees

external_queries.input: polity + context + capability + optional population/installation target
external_queries.output: yes/no/limited plus scope; combines global knowledge with local access/practice/deployment context
local theoretical/experimental/engineering band or inherited synchronized default
known pending transmissions, ETA/range when estimable, blockers when recognized

external_queries.input: proposed successor polity + inherited context/asset refs
external_queries.output: knowledge/access/practice inheritance summary based only on current factual local state
bounded summary of material scientific access/practice differences; never hidden future graph content

on_new_visible_or_mature_state: record source research context when relevant
create dissemination records only for authorized destinations that lack equivalent revision
advance synchronized civilization default only after materially connected default contexts receive equivalent codified access
remove redundant exceptions after baseline synchronization
node_state_transition_integration.rule: Scientific validity is never re-rolled per region. Context state controls access/practice, not whether the underlying physics is different.

project_integration.active_project_context: Directed research may have one or more contributing contexts, but every contributing lab/facility/expert asset must physically/informationally be available to the project.
project_integration.coordination_rule: Do not apply a universal distance penalty. Communications delay/bandwidth can block or constrain specific data/coordination dependencies when external systems report them as material.
project_integration.result_origin: Project output originates in participating context(s) and then disseminates normally.

forbidden_shortcuts: copy former polity complete known-node set
copy former polity complete competence map
grant all former capabilities regardless of local context
assume experts/factories move to new polity automatically

node_context_detail: local access states for divergent contexts
view_extension.successor_preview: show inherited records/practice/assets and uncertainties without exposing hidden future nodes
view_extension.performance: build on demand from context exceptions; do not replicate the full research tree per region in UI
